papers.summary: Here, we discover that ʟ-carnitine, an amino acid highly concentrated in skeletal muscle myocytes, drives inflammasome activation in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-challenged mice and LPS-primed murine and human macrophages.

papers.title: DNAharvester: A Nextflow Pipeline for Analysing Highly Degraded DNA from Ancient and Historical Specimens
papers.summary: We present DNAharvester, a modular and reproducible pipeline designed specifically for processing highly degraded DNA from ancient and historical specimens.

papers.title: Deepweed: Automated Individual Segmentation and Tracking for Duckweed Lineage Analysis
papers.summary: Applied to dense Wolffia populations, in both freely growing or controlled microfluidic environments, our framework can track hundreds of Wolffia plants simultaneously, resolves overlapping individuals, and reconstructs multi-generation lineage structure, enabling analyses that are inaccessible…

papers.title: Seq2Pocket: augmenting protein language models for spatially consistent binding site prediction
papers.summary: We present Seq2Pocket, a methodology for pocket-level LBS prediction that combines pLM finetuning, data enhancement, and structure-aware post-processing.

papers.title: Organotypic vascularization improves maturation of human stem cell-derived islets and restores normoglycemia in diabetic mice
papers.summary: Here, we generated vascularized PIOs (VPIOs) by co-culturing PIOs with blood vessel organoids (BVOs), resulting in integrated structures with BVOs-derived capillary networks that penetrate into the islet structures.

papers.title: PanRes: A database of latent and acquired antimicrobial resistance allowing 3D-based protein homology search
papers.summary: We developed PanRes, a curated resistance database of 11 717 genes integrating acquired and latent determinants of antibiotic, biocide, and metal resistance within a unified ontology.

papers.title: Ryder: epigenome normalization using a two-tier model and internal reference regions
papers.summary: We present Ryder, a flexible and robust Python package for the normalization of epigenomic signal tracks.

papers.title: Revisiting Batch Effect Correction: A Structured Problem Formulation and Novel Solutions
papers.summary: We present two novel methodologies for removing systematic batch effects: an unsupervised approach based on independent component analysis and a supervised approach using a domain adaptation technique.

papers.title: Female iPSC X chromosome inactivation erosion and its transcriptomic effects during CRISPR gene editing and neural differentiation
papers.summary: Here, we analyzed hundreds of RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) samples of CRISPR-edited iPSC lines for 66 genes and the matched single-neuron RNA-seq data.

papers.title: Donor-intrinsic regenerative potential outweighs histocompatibility in iPSC-derived skeletal muscle engraftment in nonhuman primates
papers.summary: Here, we generated myogenic progenitors from induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) lines derived from five major histocompatibility complex (MHC)-typed Mauritian-origin cynomolgus macaques (MCMs).

papers.title: Perinatal nicotine exposure disrupts hematopoietic stem cell development and elevates influenza severity in adulthood
papers.summary: Here, we establish perinatal nicotine exposure (PNE) as a mouse model of developmental maladaptive immunity, wherein early-life environmental insults permanently alter HSCs.

papers.title: Microbiota-derived SCFAs modulate Socs36E-mediated feedback to regulate intestinal stem cell proliferation upon Atg4 loss in Drosophila
papers.summary: Our results support a model where niche-derived metabolites drive locus-specific acetylation of Socs36E, modulating a key homeostatic node and influencing stem cell fate decisions.

papers.title: Genome-wide CRISPR screen reveals that Wnt signaling regulates lipid accumulation in APOE4 oligodendrocytes
papers.summary: Together, these findings establish a mechanistic framework linking Wnt/GSK3B signaling to APOE4-driven disruptions in oligodendrocyte lipid metabolism and myelination, pointing to GSK3B as a potential therapeutic target for APOE4-associated Alzheimer's disease.

papers.title: Skin fibroblast lineage tracing reveals layer-specific cooperation in wound repair
papers.summary: Here, we employed a dual-recombinase strategy to develop genetic lineage-tracing tools for all five layers of skin fibroblasts: papillary, reticular, hypodermal, panniculus carnosus (PC), and fascia fibroblasts.

papers.title: Multi-omics atlas of chronic exercise
papers.summary: Machine learning identified conserved exercise signatures across mammalian species.

papers.title: Functional diversification of the cephalopod proteome by RNA editing
papers.summary: Here, we integrated proteomics with biochemical and cellular assays to characterize recoding across the Doryteuthis pealeii proteome.

papers.title: An opioid efficacy switch for reversible optical control of analgesia
papers.summary: Here, we develop a reversibly photoswitchable morphinan agonist termed "azo-morphine-3" (AM-3) that interconverts from low to high efficacy in response to light to enable optical control of MOR signaling.

papers.title: Mitochondria-targeted tetraoxanes initiate lipid peroxidation to drive ferroptosis and tumor suppression
papers.summary: Our work provides a protein-targeting-independent metabolic ferroptosis induction strategy for potential cancer therapy.

papers.title: Cellular self-organization orchestrates ferroptosis propagation
papers.summary: We show that cellular self-organization constrains the propagation of ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of oxidative cell death that can otherwise spread as unbounded trigger waves.

papers.title: A phenome-wide structural variant map from 467,152 UK Biobank genomes
papers.summary: This study underscores the underestimated role of SVs in human genetics and their potential to advance understanding of human biology and drug discovery.

papers.title: scChronos: Hierarchical Temporal Context Learning for Missing Snapshot Prediction in Single-Cell Time Series
papers.summary: Beyond reducing distributional discrepancy, scChronos better preserves developmental topology and maintains cell-type-specific marker and pathway programs.

papers.title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Non–Insulin-Treated Type 2 Diabetes
papers.summary: Among adults with type 2 diabetes that was not being treated with insulin and was being managed in a primary care setting, the use of CGM led to a greater reduction in the glycated hemoglobin level and to a lower risk of hyperglycemia than routine care.

papers.title: Intermittent or Continuous Renal-Replacement Therapy in Acute Kidney Injury
papers.summary: Among critically ill patients with acute kidney injury who had indications for renal-replacement therapy, intermittent hemodialysis as the initial treatment approach was not shown to be noninferior to continuous renal-replacement therapy with respect to major adverse kidney events by day 90 and was…

papers.title: A pseudoenzyme sensor of trehalose-6-phosphate directly represses the metabolic integrator SnRK1 in plants
papers.summary: These findings resolve a long-standing question in sugar signaling and provide a framework for improving crop carbon-use efficiency.

papers.title: Representation-aware conformal prediction for reliable uncertainty quantification in drug-target affinity
papers.summary: We propose RCP-DTA, a representation-aware conformal prediction framework that constructs adaptive prediction intervals based on feature similarity.

papers.title: Microenvironment Awareness Pragmatic Analysis for Generative Enzyme Function Reasoning
papers.summary: Under cold-start conditions, the model generates reference-worthy function labels, demonstrating its practical utility for emerging enzymatic activities.

papers.title: Letters and Biological Process: Linguistic Structure Encodes Hierarchical Depth in the Gene Ontology
papers.summary: Vocabulary entropy followed a bell-shaped diversification-specialization curve with an intermediate-depth peak (maximal at depth 4) that lies outside a Monte Carlo null envelope across most depths, and null-model tests supported a genuine linguistic-hierarchical association.

papers.title: Inverse probability weighting-based mediation analysis for microbiome data
papers.summary: Application to the AML microbiome study provides evidence of a statistically significant interventional indirect effect of induction chemotherapy intensity on infection risk through alterations in the gut microbiome.

papers.title: Rapid CAR-T manufacturing with low-intensity priming enhances CAR-T cell fitness and limits inflammatory programming in a phase 1 study
papers.summary: Here, we developed PrimeCAR, a 2-day manufacturing strategy combining low-intensity anti-CD3 priming with IL-7 and IL-21.

papers.title: Single-cell CRISPR screen maps epigenetic regulators of lineage specification and malignancies in human HSPCs
papers.summary: Here, we developed a massively parallel single-cell CRISPR (scCRISPR) screening platform in primary human hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs), profiling 322 regulators across 172,382 single-perturbed cells.

papers.title: A high-dimensional population code in the bat motor cortex during natural dexterous flight
papers.summary: Here, we performed large-scale wireless recordings from the wing motor cortex of freely flying bats, combined with 3D tracking of wing kinematics.

papers.title: Mechanisms of transcription control by distal enhancers from single-gene nanoscopy
papers.summary: We find that productive interactions are dynamic, occur at a proximity of ≲100 nm, and are coordinated with transcriptional bursts.

papers.title: PTPRS mediates invasion of tetanus neurotoxin into the central nervous system
papers.summary: Thus, PTPRS is the host factor mediating TeNT trafficking into the CNS, revealing a targetable pathway for post-entry intervention and drug delivery into the CNS.

papers.title: Rare k-mers reveal centromere haplogroups underlying human diversity and cancer translocations
papers.summary: Here, we show that rare k-mers in centromeric regions capture lineage-specific variation, defining discrete haplogroups with distinct structural features.

papers.title: Mapping transcriptional responses to cellular perturbations with RNA fingerprinting
papers.summary: We demonstrate broad utility across diverse biological settings: identifying context-specific regulators of p53 under ribosomal stress, characterizing dose-dependent drug mechanisms of action, and uncovering cytokine-driven B cell heterogeneity during secondary influenza infection in vivo.

papers.title: Safeguarding global terrestrial vertebrate species from future sea level rise
papers.summary: Safeguarding SLR refugia-the noninundated habitats for exposed species-is critical, yet more than 96% lie outside protected areas, which means that early international action is required.

papers.title: Conversational diagnostic artificial intelligence in ambulatory primary care: a prospective feasibility study
papers.summary: Although further research is needed, this study shows the initial feasibility of conversational AI in a real-world setting-assessed via conversation safety and quality, as well as user acceptance-and represents a crucial step towards clinical translation.

papers.title: Oral deucrictibant for on-demand treatment of hereditary angioedema attacks: a phase 3, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial
papers.summary: Oral deucrictibant provided faster times to symptom relief than placebo and was generally well tolerated.

papers.title: Lysine-specific demethylase 1 links metabolism to stemness in human neural stem cells
papers.summary: Here, we show that lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1) governs metabolic programs essential for stemness in human fetal neural stem cells.

papers.title: Human spinal cord organoids recapitulate developmental and disease-associated oligodendrocyte lineage signatures
papers.summary: Here, we establish human spinal cord organoids (hSpO) and cortico-motor assembloids as platforms to model oligodendrocyte development, neuron-glia interactions, and cytokine-induced dysfunction.

papers.title: Characterization of structural variants in KOLF2.1J iPSCs and their potential impact on forebrain organoid differentiation
papers.summary: Here, we identified 37 additional SVs using long-read sequencing and optical genome mapping.

papers.title: A fluctuation test for gastruloid heterogeneity
papers.summary: Intrinsic, heritable fluctuations in mESC state are therefore an important source of organoid heterogeneity, and DNA Typewriter enables high-resolution lineage trees in stem cell models.

papers.title: Comprehensive lineage tracing maps the landscape of cell fate decisions in mouse embryogenesis
papers.summary: Here, we use PEtracer to continuously install heritable genetic marks as development progresses, reconstructing lineage trees that resolve ∼75% of cell divisions across >1.4 million cells from 16 replicate embryos.

papers.title: A non-canonical function of glutathione to suppress ferroptosis via FSP1
papers.summary: Together, our work clarifies a new mechanism of GSH-mediated ferroptosis suppression, thus highlighting the potential that targeting GSH metabolism should be beneficial for ferroptosis-related diseases whether or not it is related to GPX4.

papers.title: A spatiotemporal lifecycle atlas decodes spatial coordination in rice
papers.summary: Here, we combine high-resolution spatial transcriptomics, single-nucleus RNA sequencing, and a gap-free reference genome to build a 3D spatiotemporal atlas of rice, spanning 10 organs and 61 stages from seed to seed.

papers.title: SPARCS enables scalable recovery of complex image-based phenotypes for genetic screening
papers.summary: Here, we present spatially resolved CRISPR screening (SPARCS), a microscopy-based platform for forward genetic screening on single-cell images.

papers.title: Cancer competition for vitamin B2 creates metabolic checkpoint for T cell ferroptosis
papers.summary: Here, we establish the CareSLCs platform and identify that SLC52A3-mediated vitamin B2 (VB2) uptake is indispensable for T cell antitumor immunity.

papers.title: Survodutide Once Weekly in Adults with Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes
papers.summary: In adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes, survodutide at a weekly dose of 3.6 mg or 6.0 mg resulted in significantly greater weight reduction than placebo.

papers.title: Salicylic acid engages central metabolic regulators SnRK1 and TOR to govern immunity by differential phosphorylation of NPR1
papers.summary: Here, we show that NONEXPRESSER OF PR GENES 1 (NPR1), the central plant immune regulator of salicylic acid (SA)-mediated defense responses, is controlled by a cascade of post-translational modifications (PTMs) involving two master nutrient-sensing kinases.

papers.title: Retatrutide, a Triple Hormone Receptor Agonist, for Treatment of Obesity
papers.summary: In adults with obesity, retatrutide resulted in significant weight reduction, reduced pain in participants with knee osteoarthritis, and reduced apnea-hypopnea events in participants with obstructive sleep apnea.

papers.title: Gut microbiota primes stroke severity via the AHR in intestinal dendritic cells
papers.summary: Here, we identify the enrichment of indole-producing Escherichia coli being associated with worse outcomes in mice and patients with ischemic stroke.

papers.title: Spatial evolution of a cachexia-promoting microenvironment in pancreatic cancer
papers.summary: These findings provide a framework linking local tumor ecosystem dynamics to cachexia progression.

papers.title: Microbiome signatures linked to cancer and treatment adverse events in a real-world cohort
papers.summary: Here, we present findings from a real-world mixed-cancer cohort (Mayo Clinic Cancer Microbiome), comprising 1,364 cancer patients and 287 healthy controls.

papers.title: Cargo crosslinking nucleates AP-1 lattice formation
papers.summary: Here, we present cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of the human AP-1 complex bound to a cargo containing tandem sorting motifs at resolutions of 3.5 and 4.0 Å.

papers.title: Non-invasive control of gene editing in vivo by photoswitchable Cas12f and focused ultrasound
papers.summary: We demonstrate successful gene editing in the targeted skeletal muscle and brain regions of mice using AAV-transduced psCas12f and FUS.

papers.title: Opposing functions of gut immunomodulatory metabolites on CAR-T therapy
papers.summary: These findings reveal the opposing roles of immunomodulatory metabolites on CAR-T cell therapy, carrying significant implications for the design of metabolite-guided, microbiome-based therapeutics.

papers.title: In-cell discovery and characterization of a non-canonical bacterial protein translocation-folding complex
papers.summary: Here, we used the genome-reduced bacterium Mycoplasma pneumoniae as a minimal cell model and determined in-cell maps of an unknown complex located at the cell surface.

papers.title: Single-cell visual proteomics of a minimal bacterium reveals structural coordination of gene expression machineries
papers.summary: Here, we used cryo-electron tomography of native and antibiotic-perturbed Mycoplasma pneumoniae cells to resolve 140 maps that recapitulate bacterial translation during the initiation, elongation, and recycling phases.

papers.title: A pericyte-to-myofibroblast transition links APOE4 to cerebrovascular degeneration
papers.summary: We show that APOE4 pericytes transition into myofibroblasts that secrete fibronectin, which promotes vascular amyloid accumulation.

papers.title: Shifts in embryonic oxygen levels cue heterochrony in limb initiation
papers.summary: We find that mammalian limb heterochrony is evident from the start of limb bud formation and is associated with heterochronic expression of T-box transcription factors.

papers.title: Microbial signaling coordinates group oviposition and predator defense in migratory locusts
papers.summary: These findings reveal an egg-associated bacterial signaling mechanism that couples reproductive coordination with predator defense in L. migratoria.

papers.title: Direct cell-to-cell transmission of retrotransposons
papers.summary: Here, we identify a group of long terminal repeat (LTR) retrotransposons that infect the germline from somatic cells within the Drosophila ovary, despite lacking the fusogenic Envelope protein typically required for retroviral entry.

papers.title: Projection-defined modules reveal mouse motor cortex architecture
papers.summary: Here, we show that the subcortical projections of mouse MO define 16 different modules.

papers.title: CD4 T cells convert transient responses to KRAS inhibition to durable remissions in pancreatic cancer
papers.summary: Thus, IL-21-elicited CD4 T cells exert antitumor activity in mice and potentially in humans, converting transient responses to KRAS inhibition into durable remissions.

papers.title: Chloroplasts balance energy production and stress resilience via a cold-induced signaling pathway
papers.summary: Here, we identify an rapidly accelerated fifibrosarcoma (RAF)-like bi-kinase module, RAF3/6, as key mediators in chloroplast cold-stress responses.

papers.title: mRNA-encoding CD19-targeting T cell engager for refractory immune thrombocytopenia
papers.summary: These findings establish mRNA-encoded TCEs as a potent and safer therapeutic modality for B cell-mediated autoimmune diseases.

papers.title: Phosphate backbone epitranscriptomics: Discovery of natural RNA phosphorothioates and their writer machinery
papers.summary: Here, we develop sequencing- and mass spectrometry-based approaches to quantitatively map RNA PSs at single-nucleotide resolution.

papers.title: 3D chromatin remodeling during domestication defines novel targets for crop improvement
papers.summary: We reveal that domestication selection within sequence-defined sweeps fixed 57% of 3D conformation signatures, thereby decoupling sequence-level from chromatin-level selection and shifting the subgenome expression balance of 39 homoeologs in cultivated cotton.

papers.title: Gliomas phenocopy an inborn error of metabolism to drive neuronal activity and tumor growth
papers.summary: Our findings unveil a mechanism linking cancer metabolism with cancer neuroscience and leverage human genetics to nominate GAA synthesis as a target in gliomas.

papers.title: Single-cell-resolved genome atlas of prokaryoplankton inhabiting the ocean’s interior
papers.summary: This study offers a quantitative, global assessment of the composition and coding potential of microorganisms inhabiting the vast ocean's interior and contributes an extensive, single-cell-resolved dataset to microbial oceanography's cyberinfrastructure.

papers.title: Programmed ribosomal frameshifting triggers translational stress to promote viral replication
papers.summary: These findings reveal a sophisticated mechanism of viral translational control, highlighting PRF as a stress-inducing module that enhances viral replication.

papers.title: Norway spruce spatiotemporal programs of conifer reproductive development
papers.summary: Here, we present a time-resolved spatial transcriptomics (ST) atlas of 88 tissue sections across three time points from developing reproductive and vegetative shoots in wild-type Norway spruce (Picea abies), as well as transition shoots from the acrocona mutant.

papers.title: Copper ion-induced MYH9 polymerization executes cuproptosis
papers.summary: These results elucidate the mechanisms underlying cuproptosis, establish MYH9 as an executioner, and propose a treatment strategy for drug-resistant tumors.

papers.title: Tambotatug Pelitecan in Small-Cell Lung Cancer after Platinum-Based Therapy
papers.summary: Among patients with relapsed small-cell lung cancer after platinum-based therapy, treatment with tambotatug pelitecan resulted in longer overall survival, longer progression-free survival, and a higher percentage of patients with an objective response than treatment with topotecan, with a lower…

papers.title: Metax enables accurate cross-domain taxonomic profiling of metagenomes
papers.summary: By leveraging genome-wide coverage evidence, Metax enables robust cross-domain profiling across diverse sample types and sequencing depths, including settings where reference databases are highly incomplete.

papers.title: Mitochondrial ATP promotes T cell differentiation through chromatin accessibility
papers.summary: Here, we report the ability of D-α-hydroxybutyrate (DAHB) to act as a signaling molecule that increases mitochondrial ATP production and drives the conversion of proliferating T cells into cytotoxic effector cells.

papers.title: Glycocalyx-edited mesenchymal stem/stromal cell therapy in advanced osteoporosis
papers.summary: These findings indicate that glycocalyx editing effectuates MSC-based osteoporosis therapy and also refute notions that MSCs derived from older persons and/or diseased-tissue sites are biologically compromised.

papers.title: Noncoding transcription controls the developmental dynamics of long-range gene regulation
papers.summary: We propose that ncRNAs locally modulate regulatory element activity in cis to shape genome organization and orchestrate the temporal control of gene expression in development.

papers.title: Architecture of the serotonergic projectome in the mouse brain
papers.summary: Together, projectomic identity emerges as a central axis linking axon collateralization, molecular diversity, and behavioral function.

papers.title: Caloric restriction modulates genome-wide somatic mutation in mice
papers.summary: This work illuminates links between diet, aging, and genomic integrity and establishes genomic integrity as a modifiable axis of aging.

papers.title: Tozorakimab to Prevent COPD Exacerbations
papers.summary: Among patients with COPD, treatment with tozorakimab resulted in a significantly lower rate of moderate or severe exacerbations than placebo in the cohort of former smokers and in the overall population of current and former smokers.

papers.title: Structural basis of a SWI/SNF-associated transcription pre-initiation complex
papers.summary: We present high-resolution cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of both PIC-Mediator-SWI/SNF and PIC-Mediator-SWI/SNF-nucleosome complexes, together with results of cross-linking and mass spectrometry.

papers.title: Identification of the tendon/ligament stem cell in mice and humans
papers.summary: Here, we identify the TLSC present in all tendons and ligaments in humans and mice as Lin-Thy1.2-Sca-1-CD73+CD140α- cells that display self-renewal and give rise to all other tenocyte lineage cells.

papers.title: Tabula Sapiens 2.0: A comprehensive transcriptomic atlas of human cell types
papers.summary: Here, we report Tabula Sapiens 2.0, which includes data from nine new donors, doubles the number of cells, and adds four new tissues.

papers.title: Oxygen-responsive bacterial glycosphingolipid links symbiont fitness and immune development in neonatal host
papers.summary: Here, we show that Bacteroides fragilis uses a membrane glycolipid, alpha-galactosylceramide (BfaGC), to colonize the neonatal gut.

papers.title: De novo pan-rhodamine binders for fluorescence microscopy from mammalian cells to extremophiles
papers.summary: Here, we achieve this through de novo design of rhodamine binders (Rhobin).

papers.title: Catheter-Directed Thrombolysis in Intermediate-High–Risk Pulmonary Embolism
papers.summary: Among patients with intermediate-high-risk acute pulmonary embolism, catheter-directed thrombolysis with alteplase plus anticoagulation therapy led to a lower risk of death from any cause, recurrent pulmonary embolism, or cardiorespiratory decompensation or collapse within 7 days after…

papers.title: Immediate Ambulatory Electrocardiographic Monitoring in Syncope
papers.summary: Among patients with syncope that remained unexplained after evaluation in the emergency department, the use of 14-day ambulatory ECG monitoring did not result in significantly fewer patient-reported syncope episodes at 1 year than standard care.

papers.title: Pulmonary Denervation for Heart Failure–Related Pulmonary Hypertension
papers.summary: Among patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with left heart disease and heart failure receiving guideline-directed medical therapy, pulmonary-artery denervation resulted in fewer events of clinical worsening than medical therapy.

papers.title: Timing of PCI in Patients Undergoing Transcatheter Aortic-Valve Implantation
papers.summary: Among patients with severe aortic stenosis and coronary artery disease, a strategy of TAVI before PCI was noninferior to a strategy of PCI before TAVI with respect to the primary end point at 1 year.

papers.title: Prevalence of Silent Atherosclerosis across Adult Life
papers.summary: This study of silent atherosclerosis showed that the disease was detectable in early adulthood, with age- and sex-associated increases in prevalence across arterial territories and marked increases in plaque volume.

papers.title: Prasugrel versus Ticagrelor in Acute Coronary Syndromes
papers.summary: In an unselected population of patients with an acute coronary syndrome who had undergone percutaneous coronary intervention, the risk of ischemic events was not lower with a default prasugrel policy than with a default ticagrelor policy.

papers.title: Targeted Use of Computed Tomographic Coronary Angiography in Acute Chest Pain
papers.summary: In patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome in whom myocardial infarction had been ruled out, routine CT coronary angiography-guided management did not result in a lower incidence of subsequent myocardial infarction or death from a cardiac cause than standard care.

papers.title: Milvexian with Antiplatelet Therapy after Acute Coronary Syndrome Event
papers.summary: Among patients with a recent acute coronary syndrome event, milvexian did not decrease the risk of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke but did not increase the risk of intracranial or fatal bleeding, as compared with placebo.

papers.title: Clopidogrel or Dual Antiplatelet Therapy in High-Ischemic-Risk Patients
papers.summary: Among patients at high risk for ischemic events 12 months after drug-eluting stent implantation, clopidogrel monotherapy was noninferior to extended DAPT with respect to net adverse clinical events at 24 months.

papers.title: Aspirin Omission at the Time of Primary Percutaneous Coronary Intervention in STEMI
papers.summary: Among patients with STEMI who were undergoing primary PCI, low-dose prasugrel monotherapy initiated before PCI was not noninferior to DAPT for 12 months with respect to a composite of death from any cause, stroke, or myocardial infarction at 12 months.

papers.title: Eplontersen for Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy
papers.summary: Among patients with ATTR-CM, eplontersen therapy did not lead to a lower risk of a composite of death from cardiovascular causes and recurrent cardiovascular events than placebo up to 140 weeks.

papers.title: Response-Tailored or Standard-Duration Antibiotic Treatment for Infective Endocarditis
papers.summary: Among patients with infective endocarditis on the left side of the heart, the use of a response-tailored antibiotic strategy resulted in a longer time alive without antibiotic therapy than standard-duration therapy and met the criterion for noninferiority with respect to safety but was associated…

papers.title: Aficamten for Symptomatic Nonobstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
papers.summary: Among patients with symptomatic nonobstructive HCM, treatment with aficamten resulted in a significantly greater change in exercise capacity and patient-reported health status than placebo at 36 weeks.

papers.title: Genome-scale perturb-seq in primary human CD4+ T cells maps context-specific regulators of T cell programs and human immune traits
papers.summary: Here, we perturbed all expressed genes across 22 million primary human CD4+ T cells from four donors and developed a probe-based perturb-seq platform to measure the transcriptome effects in cells at rest and after stimulation.

papers.title: Integrative spatial profiling of 3D genome organization and gene expression in tissue
papers.summary: We present Spatial Hi-C-RNA, a multimodal platform that simultaneously maps genome-wide chromatin contacts and transcriptomes from the same tissue section at near-single-cell resolution.

papers.title: Gut microbiota generate dinitrosyl iron complexes with cardiometabolic benefits
papers.summary: We identify a pathway whereby gut microbes convert inorganic nitrate and non-heme iron into mobile bioactive dinitrosyl iron complexes (DNICs) that are distributed systemically and affect host metabolism.

papers.title: RNA structures regulate norovirus life cycle and enable rational attenuation in vivo
papers.summary: Here, we systematically map and functionally interrogate structured RNA elements across the murine norovirus genome using orthogonal in-cell chemical probing, revealing conserved motifs that regulate viral function.

papers.title: Multimodal brain cell atlas across the adult macaque lifespan
papers.summary: Here, we present a comprehensive transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility atlas of 2,955,873 nuclei from eight brain regions of 23 female cynomolgus macaques spanning the adult lifespan, including exceptionally old individuals.

papers.title: Brain perivascular macrophages regulate endothelial cell function via a cMAF-dependent transcriptional program in mouse and human
papers.summary: Targeting cMAF in perivascular macrophages may offer new therapeutic strategies for neurodegenerative and cerebrovascular diseases.

papers.title: Functional atlas of vertebrate viral RNA elements that stabilize RNA and enhance translation
papers.summary: Together, these findings chart the rich landscape of viral regulation, extend the scope of poly(A)-tail biology, and establish the virome as a valuable source for uncovering host RNA regulatory mechanisms.

papers.title: Rivaroxaban Then Aspirin vs. Aspirin Alone after Total Hip or Knee Arthroplasty
papers.summary: After total hip and total knee arthroplasty, the use of aspirin alone was not inferior to a strategy of using rivaroxaban followed by aspirin for the prevention of symptomatic venous thromboembolism, with no clinically relevant difference in bleeding events.
